name: openartifact
description: Use your OpenArtifact registry from the agent: configure package managers for it, check dependencies against its curation, minimum-age, quarantine and license decisions, and explain install failures. Read-only.

server_url.title: OpenArtifact URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your OpenArtifact server, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://artifacts.example.com

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: An OpenArtifact API token (oa_pat_...). A read-only token is enough and recommended.
